# get_joined_communities()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.get_joined_communities`

## Signature

```python
async def get_joined_communities() -> List['types.Chat']: ...
```

## Documentation

Get the communities you are a member of.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Returns

List of [`Chat`](../../types/user_and_chats/Chat.md): On success, the list of communities is returned.

### Example

```python
for community in await app.get_joined_communities():
    print(community.title)
```
